# Chapter 2: The Auditor

## Beat 1

Priya Raman arrived on Thursday with a thin folder under one arm. Delia Foss met Priya Raman at the front desk before the doors were properly open.

"Look at this," Priya Raman said, and spread the folder flat. "We're missing eleven months of countersignatures."

"The vault key never left me," Delia Foss said. She said it twice, and both times Priya Raman wrote it down without any comment at all.

Halloran had countersigned every one of the missing months. Emmett Rourke insisted that he had never once seen Halloran inside the building after dark.

"They're going to close the archive," Delia Foss said. "Then somebody will ask which of us lost eleven months."

Priya Raman did not disagree with her, which was worse than an argument would have been.
